# clavis schema

<p class="cli-lead">Manage the project secret schema</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis schema <command>
```

</div>

A schema lists the keys a project needs, with a type, kind, pattern and
which environment types require them. Keep it in git as
`clavis.schema.yaml` and review changes like code. [`clavis check`](./check)
validates environments against it and [`clavis codegen`](./codegen) turns
it into a typed loader.

## Examples

```sh
clavis schema infer -o clavis.schema.yaml
clavis schema push
clavis check --all
```

## Details

```yaml
DATABASE_URL:
  type: url
  kind: secret
  required: { development: true, production: true }
  description: Primary Postgres connection string
LOG_LEVEL:
  type: enum
  kind: variable
  values: [debug, info, warn, error]
```

Types: `string`, `url`, `int`, `bool`, `json`, `enum`. Kinds: `secret`,
`variable`, `file`. Optional `pattern` (regular expression), `example`
and `description`.
